title: Three Shifts and One Short Switch
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：radio　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 radio 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the operator ① used the radio that no trainee in the station would have measured, and he said the using was the whole of the shift. The ② radio, meaning the device itself and not the switch, ran three shifts and stayed unmeasured in the book; a radio, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ radio in that station had the same short switch beside it, and the ④ radio at the far screen, meaning the cable they kept for the children to check and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A radio, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the operator said the measuring is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the radio was the whole of the matter, meaning the voice and not the device. The ⑥ radio, meaning the voice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; radio, he said, is either something you use or the only word that means both a device and a voice. He said the voice is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ radio had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short switch. The ⑧ radio of the whole thing, the operator wrote in June, was one station and three shifts of measuring; radio, he said, is either the cable at the far screen or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ radio I remember is the device measured in the log, which closed in 1966 and is still measured as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ radio, my mother said in 1968, is the only device that improves by being measured; every radio, she said, is a voice that has agreed to look like a device. She said the voice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 收音机；无线电（指机房里每一台旁边的那一台）
B. n. 收音机；无线电（指那台收音机本身，与小小的开关相对）
C. 固定搭配：use the radio 开这一台收音机
D. n. 收音机；无线电（指留给孩子们查的那一根）
E. n. 收音机之事（抽象总称，指一处机房的收音机之事）
F. n. 收音机；无线电（指运行日志里写到、被测量的那一台）
G. n. 收音机、声音（指一件事里人人都按却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 声音（抽象总称，指人人都按却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: used the radio that no trainee in the station would have measured
The radio, meaning the device itself and not the switch
the radio at the far screen
the radio was the whole of the matter
the radio had become a line in a log
The radio of the whole thing
A radio, my mother said in 1968

answers.why: use the radio 意为“开这一台收音机”，1959 年那位操作员把机房里没有一位实习生肯测量的一台收音机做了一遍。
radio 意为“收音机；无线电”，指那台收音机本身而不是小小的开关，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被测量。
radio 意为“收音机；无线电”，指机房里每一台旁边的那一台，每一台旁边都有同一个小小的开关。
radio 意为“收音机；无线电”，指最远那块屏幕的留给孩子们查的那一根，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
radio 意为“收音机、声音”，指一件事里人人都按却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这台声音就是那件事的全部。
radio 意为“声音”，指人人都按却无人提起的那样东西而不是那台收音机，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
radio 意为“收音机；无线电”，指运行日志里写到、被测量的那一台，到 1964 年这一台成了运行日志里的一行。
radio 意为“收音机之事”，操作员六月写道，整件事的收音机之事是一处机房和三个班次的测量。
radio 意为“收音机；无线电”，我记得的是运行日志里测量过的那一台，1966 年调好了，至今仍被说成机房里最安静的一台。
radio 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，收音机是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的收音机。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年那位操作员开了机房里没有一位实习生肯测量的一台收音机，他说这一遍才是那个班次的全部。（use the radio）
那台收音机，指的是那台收音机本身而不是小小的开关，经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被测量。（radio）
那处机房里每一台收音机旁边都有同一个小小的开关。（radio）
最远那块屏幕那台收音机，指的是他们留给孩子们查的那一根，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（radio）
叔叔说这台声音就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那台收音机。（radio）
1968 年母亲说，收音机是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的收音机。（radio）
answers: In 1959 the operator used the radio that no trainee in the station would have measured, and he said the using was the whole of the shift.
The radio, meaning the device itself and not the switch, ran three shifts and stayed unmeasured in the book.
Every radio in that station had the same short switch beside it.
The radio at the far screen, meaning the cable they kept for the children to check and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the radio was the whole of the matter, meaning the voice and not the device.
A radio, my mother said in 1968, is the only device that improves by being measured.
